"They wrenched my trousers and my underwear down and… I was vaginally raped by
one of the male soldiers."

"He came walking to me with a taser, saying that he was going to taser my
genitals."

"I was pricked with some sort of syringe."

In the week since Israel released the hundreds of activists, humanitarians,
and journalists it abducted from the Global Sumud Flotilla that was attempting
to break its siege on Gaza, testimony after testimony has revealed only a
glimpse of the abuse, including sexual violence, inflicted on participants
while in Israeli detention.

But like the decades of
[testimony](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/11/opinion/israel-palestinians-
sexual-violence.html) given by Palestinians, [mountains of human rights
reports](https://www.ohchr.org/sites/default/files/documents/hrbodies/hrcouncil/sessions-
regular/session58/a-hrc-58-crp-6.pdf), and physical evidence, the harrowing
details described in first-hand, on-the-record accounts by those who endured
it are being largely ignored by Western media. Israel, of course,
[denies](https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/israel-denies-it-abused-
flotilla-activists-15-of-whom-claim-sexual-assaults/) any abuse.

Had any other country in the Middle East been accused of torturing and raping
Westerners, front pages worldwide would have read, 'Threatened to Taser My
Genitals' or 'I Was Raped.' The fact that they haven't underscores the
dehumanization of Palestinians and anyone who supports them.

Since Western media isn't, **Zeteo** is stepping in. We've rounded up the 11
of the most troubling accounts of the abuse Israel inflicted on the global aid
flotilla participants:

Shockingly, there are _many more_ testimonies like these. For example,
**Zeteo** contributor Alex Colston wrote in detail about his own experience
being kicked and threatened [here](https://zeteo.com/p/israel-flotilla-
detention-abuse-torture-accounts-ben-gvir).

In total, at least 35 participants suffered broken ribs, 14 reported being
sexually abused, including reports of rape, and dozens of others suffered
concussions, bruises, and nerve damage from beatings or being tightly
handcuffed, according to[ Global Sumud Flotilla participants and
organizers](https://globalsumudflotilla.org/press/us-built-us-funded-the-role-
the-united-states-played-in-the-torture-and-kidnapping-of-humanitarians/).

And while some Western governments have condemned Israel's actions against
their citizens, and in a few cases [called for
investigations](https://apnews.com/article/gaza-flotilla-france-
prosecutors-5c97c0888e8da286fc19db3240835f4a), there have been no signs that
Israel will face any meaningful consequences from those nations, many of which
continue to arm the Israeli government.
